Writes a float in 4 bytes (IEEE 754 single precision).

```blitzbasic
;run
bank = CreateBank(4)
PokeFloat bank, 0, 1.5
Print PeekFloat(bank, 0)
Print Hex$(PeekInt(bank, 0))
FreeBank bank
```

```text
1.5
3FC00000
```
@param bank    The bank to write to.
@param offset  Position in bytes.
@param value   The float to store.
